page_title: AUG 0-1 DOR | Augsburg v Dortmund 31/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+7' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Now Augsburg have a corner.
90+5' Substitution. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) has come on for Julian Brandt.
90+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Fabian Rieder (Augsburg).

90+3' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Gregor Kobel is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
87' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
85' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
84' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Augsburg.
82' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Stieler ignores the protests.
81' Today's match ends for Alexis Claude-Maurice who will be replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
81' Sandro Wagner prepares a substitution. Robin Fellhauer is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
80' The game is interrupted now, Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Dimitrios Giannoulis can be given a rest.
76' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
76' Wow, what an escape. Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
74' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Maximilian Beier and he is replaced by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund).
74' Substitution. Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) in, Yan Couto out.
72' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' The expression of the referee Tobias Stieler is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is shown a yellow card.
67' A quickly taken corner by Augsburg.
65' A yellow card for a tackle by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg). Tobias Stieler doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anton Kade (Augsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Han-Noah Massengo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Sandro Wagner decides to make a substitution. Mert Komur will be replaced by Elias Saad (Augsburg).
62' Substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka makes his way off the pitch and Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) comes on as his replacement.
62' The substitution has been made. Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) has replaced Felix Nmecha.
62' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

60' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Stieler no option but to blow his whistle. Dortmund have been awarded a free kick.
57' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
54' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
49' Today's referee Tobias Stieler rightly decides to book Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) for his harsh tackle.
49' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is booked for saying more than Tobias Stieler was willing to tolerate.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
48' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Augsburg earn a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Tobias Stieler has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
43' There's an opportunity for Pascal Gross (Dortmund) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.

36' What a chance that is! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
35' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle after Mert Komur (Augsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Dortmund have a free kick.
33' Rough tackle by Waldemar Anton (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg are awarded a free kick.
32' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Yan Couto (Dortmund) commits a foul after dangerous play. Augsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
25' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
24' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. Dortmund will take a free kick near the side line.
23' Good movement by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
20' Mert Komur (Augsburg) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
20' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Aaron Anselmino (Dortmund) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yan Couto (Dortmund) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
7' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Augsburg in a dangerous position.
3' Yan Couto (Dortmund) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
2' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
